$comment: retryUnstampedOnce: a prepare that ends without stamping the card for an unrecognised reason is re-dispatched once automatically; a second unstamped ending parks the card on the operator queue (needs-you) with both reasons. autoSize: a card held no-size (a task with no estimatedLoc, a story with no size) is routed to the item prepare, which authors the size/estimate from its touch set. runner: codex judges item preparation by the card file it edits; scope judges by the future implementation scope; claude always uses the Claude prepare session. mergedGuardHours: refuse a merged prepare PR created after the last dispatch only while its creation is within this many hours of now; 0 disables this merged refusal. Cascade: standard booleans true, runner codex, mergedGuardHours 24 → platform prepare → this file → env WE_PREPARE_RETRY_UNSTAMPED_ONCE / WE_PREPARE_AUTO_SIZE / WE_PREPARE_RUNNER / WE_PREPARE_MERGED_GUARD_HOURS.
